canonical_name: Scribbles of Strength: Write to Heal (workshop by Emily Marjean Coolbeth)
summary: Scribbles of Strength is a touring therapeutic creative-writing workshop created and led by a single facilitator, Emily Marjean Coolbeth, who books it as a one-time paid session at different host venues around the country (Story Parlor in Asheville, The Reading Attic in Marietta GA, Thought Fox in Stonington CT, and now Full Circle Community Wellness in Hendersonville). The Hendersonville listings just happen to recur monthly at the same host venue, but each session is a self-contained $20 ticketed class with no membership language, sign-up roster, or community identity - it is the facilitator's brand that recurs, not a body of attendees.

evidence.note: Listings describe a therapeutic creative-writing workshop with guided prompts and sharing circles, priced at $20, with no mention of members, dues, or a roster - each description is nearly identical across the 4 dates, consistent with a repeated class rather than a persistent group.
Venue is Full Circle Community Wellness, a mental-health/counseling center in Hendersonville, indicating the sessions are a hosted clinical/wellness program rather than a self-organized peer group.

Story Parlor's page confirms Scribbles of Strength is a one-time workshop led by facilitator Emily Marjean Coolbeth, an MFA student and writer in recovery who created the format; no ongoing group or membership is referenced.

Same workshop format ("Scribbles of Strength: Write to Heal") also ran as a single paid session at The Reading Attic in Marietta, GA, confirming this is a traveling facilitator-led class, not a location-specific community.

Web searches turned up no Facebook group, Meetup page, or website for a standing 'Scribbles of Strength' community - all hits are individual workshop listings at different venues led by the same facilitator.
